Android M Will Have Proper Visual Voicemail Support In The Dialer
Now if only manufacturers will let me use the android dialer.

What would be ideal is for Google to continue their current trend of separating different services from the core OS like they have with the Camera, Clock, etc. Place the Dialer on the Play Store and then anyone can use it.
Perhaps, but the dialer is uniquely integrated. Third party dialers don't integrate with incoming calls, for example.
An API for dialers could be included in a Play Services update couldn't it? It's in Google's best interests to get as many of their apps and services into the hands of as many people as possible.

There's an API in Android, I just don't think it's complete.

But no, you couldn't put an API in play store. It's too specific to each phone, and would require root.
I am not suggesting you put the API onto the play store, just the actual dialer as an app that hooks into an API that is distributed with the Play Services Framework.

Since it's an API tied pretty closely with the hardware, network, and protocol, it's not really a good candidate for being part of Play Services, which has become a dumping ground for APIs Google doesn't want to be part of AOSP.

But the AOSP API does exist, and it's what a third party dialer should use. Problem is, it isn't complete.

It is interesting that it has taken this long to get proper support for visual voicemail. It is such a useful feature. I originally started using Google Voice for the visual voicemail feature after moving from the iPhone 3G to the Droid M. I miss it a lot. I started a ranger a bow based ranger. I've got her up to 57 and I've been having a blast (and because I didn't read things beforehand I now know what support gems do...yeesh). Does anyone have any advice for a good gem set for a bow class? I'm all ears.
So I've been playing a week solo...

Split arrow and tornado shot are worth looking into. Popular support gems include chain, lesser multiple projectiles, added cold damage, and faster attacks. That setup would fill a 5 link (chest and/or bow). You may have mana issues, especially with chain, so using mana leech can help you sustain your attacks. If getting a six link is too expensive then i would swap added cold damage for the mana leech gem.

Explosive arrow is also popular now and uses a similar link setup. If you find a good quiver, you can try using a vaal orb on it to get the implicit +1 arrow mod.
